newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangling 96 net profit hits 43 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Jiangling 96 net profit hits 43 mln yuan.

text.p: Jiangling Motors Corp Ltd recorded net profit of 43.36 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.06 yuan in 1996 and turnover was 1.69 billion yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
The company posted net profit of 3.95 million yuan based on international accounting standards in 1995, according to the company's 1995 annual report.
Under Chinese standards, it registered net profit of 7.73 million yuan in 1995, the report said.
The firm's board of directors proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and resume in the afternoon, it said.
